def test_unique_digits():
    # Basic cases
    assert unique_digits([15, 33, 1422, 1]) == [1, 15, 33]
    assert unique_digits([152, 323, 1422, 10]) == []

    # Single element / empty input
    assert unique_digits([7]) == [7]
    assert unique_digits([]) == []

    # Sorting check (unsorted input)
    assert unique_digits([31, 13, 3]) == [3, 13, 31]

    # Zero and even digits excluded
    assert unique_digits([0, 12, 24, 35]) == [35]

    # Negative numbers: '-' is not a digit, digits of -13 are 1,3 â valid
    assert unique_digits([-13, -24]) == [-13]

    # Duplicates preserved
    assert unique_digits([11, 11, 2]) == [11, 11]

    print("All tests passed.")

test_unique_digits()
